targets.rawSql: SELECT ROUND(wattage) AS watts FROM power_logs ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT ROUND(AVG(wattage)) AS avg_watts FROM power_logs WHERE timestamp > NOW() - INTERVAL '1 hour'
SELECT ROUND(SUM(wattage) / 1000.0 / 12, 3) AS kwh FROM power_logs WHERE timestamp > NOW() - INTERVAL '5 minutes'
SELECT ROUND(SUM(total_power_kwh)::numeric, 2) AS total_kwh FROM print_jobs WHERE total_power_kwh IS NOT NULL

SELECT ROUND(AVG(electricity_cost) / NULLIF(AVG(actual_duration_seconds) / 3600, 0), 2) AS cost_per_hr FROM print_jobs WHERE status = 'COMPLETE' AND electricity_cost > 0 AND actual_duration_seconds > 0
SELECT timestamp AS time, wattage FROM power_logs WHERE timestamp > $__timeFrom() ORDER BY 1
SELECT DATE(timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Australia/Perth') AS time, ROUND(SUM(wattage) / 1000.0 / 12, 2) AS kwh FROM power_logs WHERE timestamp > $__timeFrom() GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT CASE WHEN pl.wattage > 50 THEN 'Printing/Heating' WHEN pl.wattage > 10 THEN 'Idle Warm' ELSE 'Idle Cold' END AS state, ROUND(AVG(pl.wattage)) AS avg_watts FROM power_logs pl WHERE pl.timestamp > NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC
SELECT DATE(start_time AT TIME ZONE 'Australia/Perth') AS time, ROUND(SUM(electricity_cost)::numeric, 2) AS electricity_cost FROM print_jobs WHERE start_time > $__timeFrom() GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT actual_duration_seconds / 3600.0 AS duration_h, electricity_cost AS cost, filament_type FROM print_jobs WHERE status = 'COMPLETE' AND electricity_cost > 0 AND start_time > $__timeFrom()
